settings.name: Time selection mode
settings.description: Choose the time selection mode, then choose the other setting options accordingly.

options.displayText: First specified duration of each track
Last specified duration of each track
From a specified timestamp to the end of each track
From the start of each track to a specified timestamp
Custom time range for each track

settings.name: Duration
settings.description: Only used for 'First specified duration of each track' and 'Last specified duration of each track'. Enter the length of time to select from the first location, or backwards from the last location, of each track. The value must be greater than 0. For months and years, use a whole number.

settings.name: Duration unit
settings.description: Only used for 'First specified duration of each track' and 'Last specified duration of each track'. Select the unit for the duration. Months and years are treated as calendar periods (e.g. 15 Jan + 3 months = 15 Apr).

settings.name: Start timestamp
settings.description: Only used for 'From a specified timestamp to the end of each track' and 'Between two specified timestamps'. Enter the start timestamp in UTC. All locations at or after this time are kept.

settings.name: End timestamp
settings.description: Only used for 'From the start of each track to a specified timestamp' and 'Between two specified timestamps'. Enter the end timestamp in UTC. All locations at or before this time are kept.

settings.name: Custom time table
settings.description: Only used for 'Custom time range for each track'. Upload a .csv file with one row per track and three columns: track ID, start timestamp, and end timestamp. Timestamps must be in UTC and use the format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS or YYYY-MM-DD. If the start is empty, the first location of the track is used. If the end is empty, the last location is used. A date-only end includes the entire day. Tracks not listed in the table are removed, and each track ID may appear only once.

settings.name: Track ID column name
settings.description: Name of the column with the track IDs in the custom table. The IDs must match the track IDs of the data. Also used as column name in the created time table.

settings.name: Start timestamp column name
settings.description: Name of the column with the start timestamps in the custom table. Also used as column name in the created time table.

settings.name: End timestamp column name
settings.description: Name of the column containing the end timestamps in the custom table. This name is also used for the end timestamp column in the generated editable time table.

settings.name: Create editable time table
settings.description: If selected, an editable table named 'track_time_table.csv' is created as an artefact. It contains the first and last timestamp of each track from the input data and can be edited and uploaded using the 'Custom time range for each track' mode.
